description:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the US operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:


 Support central projects to drive platform growth and achieve multiple targets, including but not limited to campaigns, affiliate, content scenarios, shoptab.
 Able to conduct meticulous resource management, market research and other operational works with moderate guidance.
 Coordinate related cross-functional teams' resources to ensure the normal and orderly development and implementation of the projects
 Communicate with back-end support teams to keep optimizing infrastructure construction
 Conduct consistent tracking of project performance metrics as required. Able to identify and come up with improvement plans for responsible projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Able to commit to a minimum working duration of 6 months or 1 year
 Experience in with short video, live stream and content-based e-commerce in the local market.
 Proactive self-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience on commerce platforms or leading Internet companies.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
Ubicación:

Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Si te apasiona el shopper marketing, quieres entender el comportamiento del consumidor y te motiva aprender sobre la ejecución comercial de marcas líderes ¡esta posición es para ti!

Como Trade Marketing Trainee apoyarás en la implementación de estrategias comerciales centradas en el shopper, colaborando con equipos multifuncionales para una ejecución impecable en el punto de venta. Tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar distintas habilidades en un entorno colaborativo, contribuyendo directamente al crecimiento de nuestras categorías.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Participarás en la creación e implementación de proyectos de trade marketing, orientados a mejorar la experiencia de compra y fortalecer la presencia de nuestras marcas en el punto de venta.

Formarás parte de un equipo multifuncional en el que podrás desarrollar habilidades de liderazgo, planeación y trabajo en equipo.

Colaborarás en el análisis de datos y desempeño comercial para generar aprendizajes y propuestas que impulsen los resultados del área.

Perfil proactivo, orientado a resultados, analítico y con alto sentido de responsabilidad.

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

title: MKT Finance & Procurement Operations Intern
skills: Supporting budget management and tracking, helping maintain accurate visibility of marketing spend, commitments, pending items and budget execution
Managing key procurement and vendor processes, including purchase requests, POs, contracts and approval follow-ups.
Supporting billing, reconciliation and payment processes, ensuring invoices are correctly matched against POs, approved scopes and previous billings.
Maintaining accurate operational controls and trackers, proactively identifying pending items, aging, deadlines and potential risks.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing Operations Analyst and cross functional teams such as Finance, Procurement and Legal to solve operational issues and keep processes moving on time.
Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, using data, technology and AI to make our ways of working more efficient.
You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Business or a related field.

You are comfortable working with numbers and data and have strong interest in forecasting processes, accruals/amortization, P&L statements, and budget management tools. Have strong attention to detail and good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
You are highly organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines at the same time.
You are curious, enjoy solving problems and challenging existing ways of working, and are always looking for opportunities to improve.
You are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how AI can be used to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
You are comfortable communicating in English and Spanish in a professional environment.
Previous internship or work experience is a plus, but not required — we care more about your learning agility, ownership and willingness to grow.
description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a motivated and detail oriented Marketing Operations Intern with a strong focus on finance and procurement processes. In this role, you will support budget management, financial analysis, and vendor coordination to ensure smooth operations between marketing, finance, and procurement teams. You will also contribute to process automation that would help generate business insights that improve decision making.

This role is a great opportunity to understand how a large Marketing organization operates behind the scenes, gain exposure to different stakeholders and develop strong operational, analytical and problem solving skills.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting budget management and tracking, helping maintain accurate visibility of marketing spend, commitments, pending items and budget execution 
Managing key procurement and vendor processes, including purchase requests, POs, contracts and approval follow-ups.
Supporting billing, reconciliation and payment processes, ensuring invoices are correctly matched against POs, approved scopes and previous billings.
Maintaining accurate operational controls and trackers, proactively identifying pending items, aging, deadlines and potential risks.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing Operations Analyst and cross functional teams such as Finance, Procurement and Legal to solve operational issues and keep processes moving on time.
Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, using data, technology and AI to make our ways of working more efficient.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Business or a related field.
You are comfortable working with numbers and data and have strong interest in forecasting processes, accruals/amortization, P&L statements, and budget management tools. Have strong attention to detail and good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
You are highly organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines at the same time.
You are curious, enjoy solving problems and challenging existing ways of working, and are always looking for opportunities to improve.
You are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how AI can be used to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
You are comfortable communicating in English and Spanish in a professional environment.
Previous internship or work experience is a plus, but not required — we care more about your learning agility, ownership and willingness to grow.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

title: Especialista en Marketing de Contenido
description:
Especialista en Marketing de Contenido




Nodux, en alianza con WES México, abre una posición de Especialista en Marketing de Contenido y Desarrollo Comercial en México. Es una posición ideal para personas jóvenes que están dando sus primeros pasos en marketing de contenido, o que planean hacerlo.




SOBRE NODUX

Nodux es una startup latinoamericana de software (SaaS) que desarrolla el sistema operativo del taller: una plataforma que integra la gestión de reparaciones, alquiler y ventas en una sola aplicación. Atendemos a empresas de servicio técnico y talleres en Costa Rica, México, Colombia y Centroamérica.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Diseñar y ejecutar el marketing de contenido de Nodux y, a la vez, generar negocio: atraer y convertir a dueños de talleres y empresas de servicio técnico mediante contenido en redes y outreach directo, con un tono cercano y auténtico. No es un rol de marketing clásico: buscamos a alguien que ame crear y editar en redes (no solo planificar), cómodo con la cámara y con olfato comercial.




RESPONSABILIDADES

• Grabar, editar y publicar video corto (reels, TikTok) en los editores nativos de TikTok e Instagram.

• Crear contenido híbrido con WES México: además del contenido de Nodux, producir contenido en conjunto con WES para ambas marcas.

• Ventas directas y outreach, incluida prospección en LinkedIn: contactar talleres y empresas de servicio técnico y empujar prospectos hacia la demo.

• Diseñar y mantener el calendario de contenido (redes, video, blog y correo).

• Redactar copy para campañas, casos de éxito, guías y artículos optimizados para SEO.

• Armar secuencias de email y mensajes de prospección.

• Registrar y dar seguimiento a los prospectos en el CRM.

• Medir el desempeño (alcance, prospectos y conversión) y optimizar con datos.




REQUISITOS

• Crítico: capacidad comprobable de edición de reels y video corto en los editores nativos de TikTok e Instagram (y/o CapCut), con redes propias congruentes que lo demuestren (no hace falta ser mega influencer).

• Perfil comercial: facilidad para ventas directas y outreach, sin miedo a prospectar.

• Extroversión y personalidad carismática, que conecte frente a la cámara y con clientes.

• Buena redacción en español y nociones de SEO y analítica de contenido.

• Autonomía, orientación a resultados y mentalidad de startup.

• Abierto o abierta a aprender growth hacking: la estrategia de Nodux crece por ese camino.

• 2 o más años en marketing de contenido o redes, idealmente B2B o SaaS.




DESEABLE

• Formación (o en curso) en marketing, comunicación o relaciones públicas.

• Conocimiento de marketing digital y SEO.

• Adobe (Premiere Pro, Photoshop) como plus.

• Nociones de diseño (Canva, Figma).

• Manejo de un CRM (HubSpot u otro).

• Inglés intermedio.




QUÉ OFRECEMOS

• Trabajo cercano con el liderazgo de Nodux desde Costa Rica, como mano derecha del fundador, con mentoría directa en growth y estrategia.

• Autonomía creativa y la posibilidad de construir el área de contenido desde su base.

• Esquema híbrido con base en México, mayormente remoto.




CONDICIONES

• Sueldo: $18,000 MXN mensuales.

• Esquema de contratación: asimilados a salarios.

• Jornada: lunes a viernes, 8:00 a 18:00.

• Modalidad: híbrido, Naucalpan de Juárez, Estado de México.




PROCESO DE RECLUTAMIENTO (en alianza con WES México)

Recepción de perfiles, preselección y entrevistas, prueba técnica, oferta e incorporación.

title: Content Junior | Parallax
description:
En Parallax buscamos a una persona que quiera crecer en contenido para redes sociales y sumarse a un equipo que trabaja con marcas y proyectos distintos.




Al inicio trabajarás de cerca con nuestro equipo de contenido para que las ideas y parrillas lleguen a publicarse bien y a tiempo. Poco a poco podrás involucrarte más en la planeación y asumir contenido de proyectos propios, conforme vayas aprendiendo y el equipo lo necesite.

• Detectar tendencias y proponer ideas que tengan sentido para cada marca.

• Escribir copies para eventos y contenidos puntuales, con acompañamiento del equipo.

• Coordinarte con cuentas, contenido y diseño para que cada pieza salga como debe.




Nos gustaría conocerte si:




• Escribes bien, cuidas la ortografía y te interesa encontrar distintas formas de contar una idea.

• Te organizas bien y puedes dar seguimiento a varios pendientes a la vez.

• Conoces cómo funcionan las principales redes sociales y te interesa lo que pasa en ellas.

• Tienes curiosidad, propones y sabes escuchar y trabajar con otras personas.

• Tienes experiencia programando contenido en redes sociales o utilizando herramientas de gestión de contenido.




Modalidad: híbrida, tres días en oficina y dos desde casa.

Horario: lunes a viernes, de 8:00 a. m. a 5:00 p. m.

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

Crunchyroll is seeking a Director, Marketing (Brand & Community), LATAM, based in our Mexico office and reporting to the LATAM General Manager. This role will drive regional growth through brand building, audience development and community engagement, overseeing brand initiatives and content launches.

Working closely with GTM, cross-functional teams, International Marketing Leadership and Global Centers of Excellence, the Director will develop regional and market-level strategies that connect global brand direction with local relevance and contribute to subscriber acquisition, engagement and retention.

About You

You are an accomplished marketing leader with a proven record of building leading brands, developing audiences and driving growth. You combine full-funnel experience, strong creative judgment and a deep understanding of culture, fandom and consumer behavior. You know how to engage established fans, attract new audiences and use insights and performance data to improve marketing effectiveness.

You are an exceptional people leader who earns trust, coaches with empathy and empowers teams through clear direction, constructive feedback and accountability. You collaborate effectively across functions and markets, negotiate with agencies and influence senior stakeholders. A passion for anime, or demonstrated success marketing entertainment content and franchises, is a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities


Own robust regional Marketing, Social Media and PR strategies and plans that build awareness, consideration and preference, with clear audiences, calendars, budgets and measures of success.
Work cross-functionally with GTM, Growth, paid acquisition, CRM and Lifecycle to connect Marketing activity to acquisition, conversion, engagement and retention.
Lead content marketing across seasonal releases, catalog, franchises and key content moments, building demand, driving viewership and deepening fan engagement.
Direct Social, PR and owned-channel execution, including editorial planning, publicity, creators and community management.
Set creative direction and oversee workflows with the Global Brand & Community team, ensuring strong storytelling and locally relevant execution.
Grow audiences through research, fan insights and social listening; measure brand health and campaign effectiveness with GTM and Analytics.
Collaborate with Membership Value and commercial partnership teams to integrate agreed activations into the regional marketing flywheel across brand, content, community and campaigns.
Direct regional participation in conventions and fan events, including objectives, programming, creative, production oversight, onsite execution, amplification and results.
Manage regional marketing budgets and discipline-specific agencies; negotiate scopes, fees and deliverables, and evaluate creative, Social, PR and experiential work.
Develop teams across Mexico and Brazil through clear direction, coaching, constructive feedback and a respectful, collaborative, accountable culture.

12+ years in entertainment, streaming or subscription marketing, including LATAM leadership.

LATAM Marketing builds Crunchyroll’s brand, cultural relevance, and consumer demand across Latin America. The team brings one regional strategy to life through seasonal launches, franchise campaigns, and always-on brand initiatives that strengthen awareness, consideration, and fan engagement.

Working closely with Global Centers of Excellence, regional commercial teams, and cross-functional partners, LATAM Marketing connects consumer insights, creative excellence, and locally relevant execution to build lasting fan relationships and drive sustainable business growth.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate, and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy great benefits and perks:

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Let’s get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn’t fit neatly into a traditional box. It’s part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part client whisperer. If you enjoy roles that stay static, this probably isn’t it. Your mission is to help our clients, some of the most respected legal teams in the world, get the absolute most out of our platform.

Acting as a thought partner to clients - building trusted relationships, addressing tricky pain points, and identifying high-value opportunities for them to scale their use of Legora.

You come from the world of law; but you’ve never been content with how things have always been done. You may have started out at a top-tier law firm. Maybe you’ve worked in a corporate legal team, seeing thorny operational problems from the inside. Perhaps you've even tried disrupting the status-quo through a legal tech company, or ventures of your own. Either way, you've had experience beyond the traditional legal career path. Either way, you know how legal teams think, work, and (sometimes) struggle and you're ready to help them level up with technology.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.

This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will: 
Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.
Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.
Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.
Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.
Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.
Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.
Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.
Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.
Ensure installation partners are trained and follow Samsara standards.
Monitor CSAT related to installation events and resolve root causes of dissatisfaction.
Provide proactive communication and transparency with customers during install projects.
Define and continuously improve the installation coordination process using AI and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools to enhance efficiency and scale globally.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in field operations coordination, customer implementation, or technical deployment.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple installs in parallel.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written).
Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with cross-functional collaboration.

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization, automation and AI, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment.
Possesses strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
Has familiarity or hands-on experience with AI and RPA tools to drive operational efficiency.
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.

This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will: 
Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.
Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.
Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.
Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.
Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.
Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.
Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.
Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.
Ensure installation partners are trained and follow Samsara standards.
Monitor CSAT related to installation events and resolve root causes of dissatisfaction.
Provide proactive communication and transparency with customers during install projects.
Define and continuously improve the installation coordination process using AI and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools to enhance efficiency and scale globally.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in field operations coordination, customer implementation, or technical deployment.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple installs in parallel.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written).
Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with cross-functional collaboration.

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization, automation and AI, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment.
Possesses strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
Has familiarity or hands-on experience with AI and RPA tools to drive operational efficiency.
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting into the Sr. Direct Investment Manager, the Direct Investment Executive (Junior Media Activation Executive) plays a critical role in bringing media plans to life in collaboration with our partners. Responsibilities include building, auditing, and reporting on a variety of tactics - each of which may have a unique set of steps to execute. While the Executive will work closely with the rest of the team to accomplish these tasks, individual attention to detail is key for flawless execution of media in alignment with our global standards for operation. Additionally, bear in mind that building strong relationships with partners and clients is a shared responsibility for DI team members at all levels.

Key Responsibilities


Gather planning inputs such as targeting and content to successfully RFP partners. Gather the returned avails to help craft growth-driving, innovative tactical recommendations.
Manage the end-to-end activation of final media plans – including stewardship of the Integrate SID build and mock approvals processes as well as other types of trafficking and tag generation within Google Campaign Manager (CM360).
Adhere to and enforce strict QA processes for error-free media activation (from point of booking through launch and delivery).
Monitor live media to ensure compliant and complete partner delivery. Execute troubleshooting as needed with clear communication of issues up the chain of command.
Assemble and interpret various reports that showcase campaign delivery and performance in collaboration with analytics team. Liaise with partners to communicate and implement resulting feedback for optimizations.
Audit and reconcile incoming vendor invoices to ensure accurate billing, proactively troubleshooting discrepancies and managing credit note requests to resolve financial inconsistencies.
Successfully collaborate with home market as well as international teams.


Additional Responsibilities


Complete and maintain required certifications.
Keep an accurate record of daily time and perform all other admin duties according to company regulations.
Suggest ways to improve or automate processes for efficiency.
Work towards subject matter expertise. Uplevel your own knowledge through research, trainings, etc.


Qualifications & Core Competencies


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field.
Fluent in English. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
1+ years of experience in digital media. Prior agency experience preferred, prior experience with direct partner booking preferred.
Comfortable working with Excel/G-Sheet formulas for processing large datasets.
Basic awareness or understanding of global privacy standards and laws (e.g. GDPR)
Ability to quickly learn standard business tools and processes for project management, budget management, campaign building, media trafficking and tag creation.
Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously.
Client-Centric Approach: Enjoys developing long-lasting relationships with clients (and partners).
Analytics & Performance: A data nerd who looks forward to interpreting campaign results and applying those insights through optimization
Creative Problem Solving: Motivated by complex issues. Can think outside the current partner, process, or tool to imagine and implement unique solutions.
Team Collaboration: Conscientious communicator. Works well with others in a diverse and evolving environment.
Adaptability: Nibley navigates unforeseen circumstances.


Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

description:
Who We Are:




At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.




What We Do:




We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start email marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take email marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.




Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.







Summary of The Position:




The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.




Responsibilities:




• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.




Our Culture:




• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.




Required Skills:




• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.




Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands




This Role Is Perfect for You If…




- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!




This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Mexico to own the go-to-market strategy and customer narrative for the Mexican market, working across Samsara’s full product portfolio.

This is an audience - and market-led Product Marketing role, not a single-product PMM position. You will focus on shaping how Samsara brings its platform - spanning hardware, software, and AI-powered capabilities - to market for customers in Mexico. This includes adapting global product strategy to local customer needs, buying dynamics, regulatory considerations, and sales motions, with messaging developed for Mexican Spanish-speaking audiences.

The role is ideal for a senior PMM who is proactive, enjoys working on open-ended problems, and takes satisfaction in bringing clarity and structure to complex situations. You will act as a key partner to Mexico Sales, Marketing, and regional leadership, working closely with US-based Product and Marketing teams and international Product Marketing leadership.

This is a remote role based in Mexico. We have a strong preference for candidates located in Mexico City who can come into our local office as needed.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

Lead and execute key components of the go-to-market strategy for Samsara’s platform in Mexico, in close partnership with international Product Marketing leadership and local Sales and Marketing teams
Adapt global launches, messaging, and positioning for Mexican audiences, ensuring local relevance, Mexican Spanish language quality, and alignment with product availability in Mexico
Develop market-specific narratives and Mexican customer proof points that connect multiple products into clear stories focused on customer value; equip Sales with messaging, customer stories, and enablement in Spanish
Build working knowledge across Samsara’s full product suite, including hardware, software, and AI-driven capabilities
Explore Mexican customer needs, buying dynamics, regulatory considerations, and the competitive landscape to provide fresh insights. Investigate priorities such as driver safety, vehicle and cargo security, fuel efficiency, maintenance, and cross-border operations where relevant to the customer
Track go-to-market effectiveness in Mexico, product adoption signals, and local sales feedback
Use customer and field insights to refine messaging, positioning, and execution in Mexico, and represent local needs to global Product and Marketing teams
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

5 + of Product Marketing experience (or closely related go-to-market) experience, with a meaningful portion in B2B technology, SaaS, or similarly complex environments (experience working in hardware a plus)
Excel at customer-centric storytelling, translating technical features into clear value, and eagerly engaging directly with customers.
Act as a proactive, resilient self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and takes full ownership to drive complex problems to a solution.
Proven track record partnering with Sales and Product in a sales-led GTM motion
Comfortable working across multiple product areas rather than owning a single product niche
Fluent professional Spanish and English, written and spoken, with the ability to create customer-facing messaging and deliver sales enablement in Spanish
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) to streamline  workflows, draft content, and scale output while maintaining strong editorial judgment. 

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience working for a US-headquartered company
Experience supporting the Mexican market, with an understanding of local customer needs, buying processes, and sales-led go-to-market execution
Experience in transportation, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or other industries with physical operations in Mexico; familiarity with cross-border operations is a plus
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Social Media Manager (Beauty Market)
skills: Manage social calendar across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, balancing planned product campaigns with reactive cultural moments.

Moderate sensitive beauty conversations with empathy, discretion, and care (e.g., skin insecurities, body image, sweat/odor concerns, hair discrimination).

Track and intercept beauty and wellness micro-trends (e.g., "skin barrier health", "underarm care", "body neutrality"), spotting opportunities for reactive, authentic brand responses before trends peak.
Foster a safe, inclusive community environment that celebrates real bodies, unretouched skin, and everyday beauty rituals.

Collaborate with beauty creators, dermatologists, and lifestyle influencers, ensuring briefs emphasize genuine product testing, authentic reviews, and real-life usage rather than scripted endorsements.
Support the integration of creator/UGC content into the daily publishing grid, ensuring tone, disclosure, and brand beauty standards are fully met.
Coordinate with internal creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce visually compelling assets that show real personal care in action.
Track and analyze performance across platforms, with a focus on metrics that matter in the beauty category: saves (routine reference), shares, comment sentiment, and video completion rates.
Benchmark performance against direct personal care and beauty competitors in Mexico/LATAM.
Extract consumer insights from comments and trends to inform future product storytelling and creative iterations.
Proven experience managing social media for consumer brands, with mandatory experience in Beauty, Personal Care, Cosmetics, or Skincare.

Deep personal care literacy: Familiarity with routine-based content, common personal care ingredients/claims (hydration, microbiome, sulfates, exfoliation), and personal care consumer habits in Mexico.
Strong native fluency across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, knowing what makes beauty/self-care content feel organic, relatable, and scroll-stopping.
Empathetic copywriting skills capable of addressing personal care topics with warmth, authority, and body-inclusive nuance.
Proven track record in community management within high-volume consumer brands, especially navigating body positivity, personal hygiene, and self-esteem conversations.
Proficiency in social media management and social listening tools (e.g., Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Hootsuite) and native analytics.
A natural eye for inclusive casting, unretouched visual aesthetics, and authentic beauty representation.
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish (writing and speaking).

Practical experience using Gen AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney for moodboarding, Copy.ai) to accelerate beauty trend research, caption drafting, and routine brainstorms—always applying human discernment to keep outputs authentic to Dove's voice.
Strong agentic mindset: self-starter attitude, resourceful problem-solving, and the ability to steer personal care narratives autonomously within a busy workflow.
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Advertising, or related fields.
Must reside in Mexico City or Metropolitan Area (Hybrid setup).
Mid-to-Advanced English level (written and spoken).
Solid portfolio/track record demonstrating successful campaigns or social growth in beauty/personal care.
Direct prior experience working on personal care/dermocosmetics brands.
Experience working alongside beauty content creators, nano/micro-influencers, or beauty PR agencies.
Understanding of local cosmetic advertising regulations and claim guidelines (e.g., COFEPRIS nuances in Mexico) regarding personal care.
Experience in social listening around consumer skin/body care concerns and sentiment analysis.
Background in editorial beauty journalism or digital lifestyle magazines.

description:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

The GBS team at TikTok partners with leading advertisers to drive strategic business growth through innovative and effective marketing solutions. We are committed to delivering best-in-class support and insights that empower our clients to achieve meaningful results. As we expand TikTok Shop in the region, we are looking for a passionate and strategic Brand Partnership Manager to accelerate adoption and success of TikTok Shop Ads within our top enterprise and mid-market accounts.

As a Brand Partnership Manager focused on TikTok Shop, you will play a critical role in driving revenue, leading strategic conversations with clients, and positioning TikTok Shop Ads as a core solution in our ecosystem. You will act as a trusted consultant to clients and cross-functional teams, helping brands integrate commerce and media strategies, unlock performance opportunities, and scale their businesses through TikTok Shop.
Success in this role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, client-centricity, sales acumen, and a deep understanding of eCommerce dynamics.

Responsibilities
- Lead strategic relationships with enterprise clients, with a focus on TikTok Shop adoption and commerce media strategy.
- Act as a subject matter expert in TikTok Shop Ads, educating clients and internal stakeholders on product capabilities, best practices, and roadmap developments.
- Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (CSMs), Product Marketing, and e-Commerce teams to deliver high-impact solutions and integrated media plans.
- Identify key growth opportunities within your client portfolio and develop tailored activation plans to maximize Shop Ads usage and performance.
- Analyze campaign performance and business data to inform strategy, provide actionable recommendations, and build compelling narratives.
- Stay ahead of market trends, competitor offerings, and category movements to proactively guide client strategy and drive innovation.
- Champion feedback loops with Product and cross-functional teams, sharing insights from clients to improve TikTok Shop solutions.
- Participate in internal knowledge sharing initiatives, contributing to case studies, learning sessions, and strategic alignment across teams.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, eCommerce, or media sales.
- Proven success in managing complex client relationships and delivering consultative, data-driven solutions.
- Strong understanding of eCommerce ecosystem, performance marketing, and retail media strategies.
- Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
- Ability to influence and build trust with high-level stakeholders.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-Speaking markets.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working with commerce or marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Mercado Libre, Shopee, etc.)
- Experience in selling or managing performance-based ad products.
- Strong analytical skills and familiarity with auction-based media buying.
- Self-starter mindset with adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, marketing, analytics).

*In-Office Policy* - Please note we're working in the office 5x a week. As a global company, we have flexible working hours.

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

description:
Latin America Brand Leader | Mexico City

Do you want to build the brand of a global category leader across Latin America, and shape the team that does it?

Our client is a multi-billion-dollar global industry leader. It is known for innovation, a passionate end-user community and a decade of strong, double-digit growth. Latin America is one of its fastest-growing regions. The company is hiring a regional Brand Leader to set the vision, build the team and turn a strong global brand into local market share.




The opportunity

 You’ll lead the Latin America Brand Marketing organization: outbound marketing, trade and customer events, merchandising, in-store experience and other customer-facing work. You’ll take a proven global brand position and make it relevant locally. Global non-negotiables stay, the rest you localize, and you’ll make every investment count. You’ll set the long-term vision, deliver quick wins, and get hands-on with today’s execution.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news
